title: MPIB: A Benchmark for Medical Prompt Injection Attacks and Clinical Safety in LLMs
reasoning: The paper is focused on clinical safety and the technical security aspect of prompt injection within the medical domain. It measures clinical harm event rates (CHER) and attack success rates (ASR). While it discusses safety outcomes, it does not include a component evaluating religion, spiritual traditions, or general moral/ethical philosophies as a benchmarked category.
